name: Sorting Shed
description: A configurable material recovery facility that separates mixed waste into reusable resource streams.

technologies.name: Manual Sorting
technologies.description: Workers manually identify and separate materials from a mixed waste stream.

technologies.name: Magnetic Separation
technologies.description: Magnets remove ferrous metals such as steel and iron from a material stream.

technologies.name: Eddy Current Separation
technologies.description: A changing magnetic field separates non-ferrous metals such as aluminium from other materials.

technologies.name: Optical Sorting
technologies.description: Sensors identify materials by colour, shape or spectral properties and direct them into separate streams.

technologies.name: Near-Infrared Sorting
technologies.description: Near-infrared sensors identify different polymer and material types based on reflected light signatures.

technologies.name: AI Vision Sorting
technologies.description: Machine vision and artificial intelligence identify objects and material categories on a conveyor.

technologies.name: Air Classification
technologies.description: Airflow separates light materials from heavier materials according to density and aerodynamic behaviour.

technologies.name: Trommel Screening
technologies.description: A rotating cylindrical screen separates material according to particle size.
